summary.text: María Elena Durazo, a Democrat, represents the 26th Senate District in the California State Senate.

paragraphs.text: Her official website says she graduated from St. Mary's College of California in 1975, earned a law degree from the People's College of Law in 1985, became Executive Vice President of UNITE-HERE International in 2004, and was Secretary-Treasurer of the Los Angeles County Federation of Labor from 2006 to 2014.

Colorado Boulevard's report on final results says Durazo received 60.58% of the vote in the June 2, 2026 primary for Los Angeles County Supervisor, 1st District, ahead of Elaine Alaniz at 13.53%; The Eastsider reported she declared victory.
